title: Lior and the Veil
author: Theo Thackeray
blurb: Quentin Reyes, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
